hoaxes.title: OpenAI will publish its new AI math proofs as a printed puzzle book for schools
hoaxes.truth: Made up. OpenAI says AI found results including a disproof of the Exponential Time Hypothesis; review will take months.

hoaxes.title: Clayface tickets come with a free tub of modelling clay at select cinemas
hoaxes.truth: Made up. DC's Clayface opened at No. 1 with $24 million in North America and about $43 million worldwide.

hoaxes.title: Phantom Blade Zero adds a mode where every boss must be beaten with a paper fan
hoaxes.truth: Made up. Phantom Blade Zero launches October 29 and has an 88 on Metacritic for PC from 23 critics.

hoaxes.title: Apple's new OLED iPad mini can fold in half like the iPhone Duo
hoaxes.truth: Made up. The new iPad mini has an 8.5-inch OLED screen, an A20 Pro chip and IP67 rating, from $699.
